rightsCaveat: Current original Sketchfab item is unavailable (API 404). License evidence is preserved in original-format mirror license, original glTF asset.extras, and optimized GLB extras. No claim that current original page offers download.
runtimeModifications: Decode Meshopt integer attributes to floating point, normalize units/heading, retain source cabin, map native hood/hatch/side windows and interior door parts to seven presentation hinges, partition remaining merged surfaces, assign material roles, preserve source texture maps, add a recessed front compartment liner, configure rolling wheels and steering-only calipers.
